indicator_name: Capacity utilisation by sector (NBK enterprise monitoring survey)
description: Уровень загрузки производственных мощностей по отраслям (мониторинг предприятий НБ РК)
methodology: Weighted average across respondents, quarterly from 2016-Q2, dated like the scalar CAPACITY_UTILIZATION (item TOTAL = that series). Sectors mapped to ОКЭД letters; NRS = the NBK's pool of sections N, R, S.
